issue.title: Several things about parsing
issue.body:
A few things I noticed:

1. Parsing `31/12/2024` sometimes gives the wrong month, not sure if I'm using it wrong.
2. It would be nice to have a `strict=True` mode.
3. Also, is there a way to get the day of the week back?

Let me know which of these I should open separately.
